title: Appointed as Assistant
original: This here Croissant guarantees yer safety, no matter where yer headin', Baws! Oh, 'n payment's upfront! 'Member that!

title: Talk 1
original: Make a buncha money workin' yer butt off! We can't be livin' in no poverty, after all!

title: Talk 2
original: Yer kiddin'! All yer people got such shiny gear on 'em! Lemme have a touch too!

title: Talk 3
original: Boy, I sure love orderin' new gear! Feels like I bought enough stuff to fill the whole depot! This what they call a 'shoppin' addiction'?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Every month there's more 'n more bills to pay... 'n that's why I sell some stuff I find on the side! Everythin' I got is cheap 'n high quality!

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Move this, lift that. If we gotta be haulin' things, might as well pick some easy-to-use and yummy-yummy stuff!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Baws, Baws! Found this here heckin' tasty thing lyin' around, ya want a bite? Ya ask me, the only thing second to gud gear is gud food!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Baws, c'mere a sec, wouldja? Take a gander at my wares! From fancy clothes 'n everyday items to office supplies and gear, ya name it, I got it! Buy in bulk 'n I'll give ya a discount!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Baws, I gotta thank ya! With all them referrals, I can buy everything I ever wanted! Yer the best, Baws! Love ya lots!

title: Idle
original: Aw shucks, gotta tighten my belt again this month...

title: Onboard
original: The name's Croissant, and by golly yer in luck, Baws! Won't find nobody as good at their trade as I am! I'm strong, don't break easy, 'n if ya hire me right now, I'll give ya a 20% discount!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I reckon I'll get more work if I get stronger!

title: Promotion 1
original: Thank ya kindly, Baws, fer helpin' me find such a nice job.

title: Promotion 2
original: Baws, Baws, I made good use of that there bonus ya gave me! Check it out, I don’t got myself some new gear. All the better to keep ya safe!

title: Added to Squad
original: Leave the defense to me!

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Listen up, y'all! Let's do this here mission nice and cleanlike!

title: Depart
original: We'll be back with the best results ya ever did see!

title: Begin Operation
original: Well lookee here. The bad guys're comin' to donate their gear!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: What can I do ya for?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Time to try this here new gear!

title: Deployment 1
original: H'all righty!

title: Deployment 2
original: Here we are!

title: In Battle 1
original: End of the road!

title: In Battle 2
original: Ya ain't gettin' through me!

title: In Battle 3
original: THUNDERCLAP!

title: In Battle 4
original: That ain't gon' work on me!

title: 4-star Result
original: Ya reckon the enemy dropped a treasure chest or somesuch?

title: 3-star Result
original: Yeehaw! Mission accomplished!

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Dagnabbit... the enemy got away! That ain't good for my rep…

title: Operation Failure
original: Aw, shucks… First I lost the fight, and now my wallet…

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Ya got any treasure chests hidin' 'round here?

title: Tap
original: Hmm?

title: Trust Tap
original: Baws, Baws, got any nifty stuff on hand? C'mon, I wanna see!

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Baws! The Penguin Logistics girls're countin' on yer business. And my hammer and shield'll keep yer goodies safe wherever they need to go. Hehe, if'n ya trust me enough, feel free to cut out Emperor and send the job straight to me!

title: Greeting
original: Howdy, Baws!

title: Birthday
original: Shhh! Rise n' shine, Baws. Get'cher clothes on! We gotta move before the others wake up. Texas's got the engine runnin', and Exusiai's talkin' about a champaign buffet with all the rubber bullets we'n shoot. Relax, Baws, we know a thing or two about birthday parties.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Even yer most carefully-laid plan ain't gonna carry you outta the swamp when yer all stuck in it. That's when ya come lookin' fer the unstoppable force! Hold the shiny equipment! That's the reason Rhodes Island n' Penguin Logistics're like two peas in a pod! Here's to keepin' that unstoppable force rollin', Baws!
